requirements: Opening product recovery must discover a good previous health copy beside an existing damaged current root before any unrelated write. Preserve exact current and previous bytes; never silently install history or import prior Health intent.

Capture immutable hard-linked inputs under the common swap lock; perform bounded JSON validation and any potentially large comparison outside that lock. Read-only previews and source verification must remain lock-independent.

Before publishing a discovery copy, recheck actual current/prior path identities and relevant tree stamps, cancellation and completed-erasure marker. Reset or source replacement during preparation must reject stale publication and must not revive erased records.

Carry private copies found only in previous without recursive mirrors. Stable source identity and actual linked-tree comparison must avoid repeated discovery growth; ambiguous or changed existing copies reject rather than being overwritten.

Publish private copies without retiring previous, replacing current files, changing conversations or rotating intent. Preserve originals on capture/preparation/publication failures. Clean only owned snapshot staging; keep interrupted-staging cleanup scoped and no-follow.

Skip the private recovery area during initial unlocked transaction cloning; carry its latest state under the final serialized commit, including discoveries published after preparation. Retain exact revision/current-source checks.

Integrate discovery in the actual product load path. Change the synthetic UI fixture to leave a good unarchived previous copy at launch, then rerun actual core and main/compact light/dark/largest flows with source-bound independent final file audits. Continue the same design critic for any changed states.
requiredChecks: Unchanged actual baseline becomes immediately readable while both exact original water files remain; repeated discovery does not grow copies.
Preparation can finish while another worker holds the swap lock after input capture; preview and verify remain independent of that lock.
Current and prior replacement/in-place mutation, late unrelated commit, reset marker and explicit cancellation reject stale publication; no private copy appears after rejection.

Prior-only retained copies, damaged retained copies, photos/raw directories and intent provenance survive without old work becoming live; unsupported unsafe paths reject without following or deleting their targets.
A transaction prepared before discovery still carries the new private copy on commit; failed/discarded transactions retain current and prior originals.
boundary: Full recovery/backup/legacy/symlink-target support, failure/retry/busy Cancel, all original contracts/eight durable groups, actual HealthKit/interruption/device/Release/publication and the broader product goal remain open.
